highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 adds a Vulkan Silk.NET package, memory and performance fixes, and broader platform support.
highlights_body: This release adds the new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET integration package, brings FreeType-based font rendering to Nano Server, fixes a native memory leak in SKImage.Create, and sharpens runtime performance via reduced allocations.

bullets.lead: Skia submodule synced to latest upstream
bullets.detail: Pulls in the latest Skia engine changes and refreshes the cgmanifest to keep the bundled renderer current.
Adds a first-class Vulkan integration package that targets Silk.NET, with Vulkan test coverage running on both Android and Linux CI legs.

bullets.lead: Native memory leak in SKImage.Create raster failure path fixed
bullets.detail: A CoTaskMem pixel buffer was not freed when the raster image creation failed, causing a native memory leak on every failed create call.

bullets.lead: Reduced allocations in hot text and shader paths
bullets.detail: GetEncodedText avoids an intermediate string allocation on the null-terminated fast path, and SKRuntimeEffectUniforms pre-sizes its lookup map to the known uniform count, cutting per-frame allocations.

bullets.lead: FreeType font support for Nano Server
bullets.detail: Nano Server's restricted GDI environment no longer prevents font rendering: the build now uses FreeType as the font backend, fixing long-standing text rendering failures on Nano Server containers.

bullets.lead: Containerized test coverage for Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server
bullets.detail: New CI test legs run the full SkiaSharp test suite inside Azure Linux, Alpine (musl libc), and Nano Server containers, catching platform-specific regressions earlier.
All .sln solution files have been converted to the new .slnx format, reducing merge noise and aligning with modern .NET tooling.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Added FreeType-based font rendering support for Nano Server, fixing text rendering in restricted GDI environments
